from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    nrows, ncols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the hollow, color-5 square frame.
    rows = [r for r in range(nrows) if 5 in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(ncols) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(nrows))]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(nrows) for c in range(ncols)
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    markers.sort(key=lambda item: item[1])
    left_color, right_color = markers[0][2], markers[1][2]
    # The two outside markers set the adjacent pair of quadrants; colors
    # alternate diagonally across the framed interior.
    top_adjacent = all(r < r0 for r, c, color in markers)
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            upper = r < (r0 + r1) / 2
            left = c < (c0 + c1) / 2
            same = (upper == top_adjacent) == left
            out[r][c] = left_color if same else right_color
    return out
'''
file=program_dir/'task-7588d669.py'
file.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(file),'exec'))
